source_en: Your booth casts a strange shadow. Nini Bitsadze. I paint.
I've painted the light since the dust. Everything's lit from below now.
The east road, mostly. The light is best near the closed zone.
Everything has an amber cast. Strange and honest. It won't last.
The [[infected:charcoal on my hands]] never comes off. Tamar checks on me mornings.
That's what the last officer said. Every time. I started counting.
My caretaker. I have a condition. It's managed.
You have a good face for charcoal. I've been sketching it since I got in line.
